* A record of a TLS handshake. For HTTPS clients, the client is local * and the remote server is its peer. * *

This value object describes a completed handshake. Use {@link * javax.net.ssl.SSLSocketFactory} to set policy for new handshakes. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static Handshake get(String cipherSuite, List<Certificate> peerCertificates, List<Certificate> localCertificates)
public String cipherSuite()
methods.comment: Returns a cipher suite name like "TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA".

methods.name: public List<Certificate> peerCertificates()
methods.comment: Returns a possibly-empty list of certificates that identify the remote peer.

methods.name: public Principal peerPrincipal()
methods.comment: Returns the remote peer's principle, or null if that peer is anonymous.

methods.name: public List<Certificate> localCertificates()
methods.comment: Returns a possibly-empty list of certificates that identify this peer.

methods.name: public Principal localPrincipal()
methods.comment: Returns the local principle, or null if this peer is anonymous.
